description.zh:
预付费实例购买时长。
- 当**Period**为**Year**（包年）时，取值范围为**1**~**5**。
- 当**Period**为**Month**（包月）时，取值范围为**1**~**60**。

> 当**ChargeType**为**Prepaid**（预付费）时，该参数才有效且必须传入。
description.en:
The subscription duration of the instance.
- If Period is set to **Year**, valid values are **1** to **5**.
- If Period is set to **Month**, valid values are **1** to **60**.

> This parameter is valid and required only when ChargeType is set to **Prepaid**.

description.zh:
修改后的付费方式，取值：
- **PrePaid**：预付费，即包年包月。
- **PostPaid**：后付费，即按量付费。
<props="china">
- **sync_serverless**：后付费Serverless。</props>
description.en:
The billing method after conversion. Valid values:
- **PrePaid**: subscription.
- **PostPaid**: pay-as-you-go.
<props="china">
- **sync_serverless**: pay-as-you-go Serverless.</props>.

description.zh: 同步或订阅任务ID，可调用[DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~)查询。
description.en: The ID of the data synchronization or change tracking task. You can call [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) to query the task ID.

description.zh:
Serverless实例的DU上限，取值为：2、4、8、16。
<props="intl">
> 当前暂不支持此功能，请勿传入参数。</props>
<props="china">
> 当**ChargeType**为**sync_serverless**时，该参数才有效且必须传入。</props>
description.en:
The maximum number of DUs for the Serverless instance. Valid values: 2, 4, 8, and 16.
<props="intl">
> This feature is currently not supported. Do not specify this parameter.</props>
<props="china">
> This parameter is valid and required only when ChargeType is set to **sync_serverless**.</props>.

description.zh:
Serverless实例的DU下限，取值为：1、2、4、8、16。

<props="intl">
> 当前暂不支持此功能，请勿传入参数。</props>
<props="china">
> 当**ChargeType**为**sync_serverless**时，该参数才有效且必须传入。</props>
description.en:
The minimum number of DTS Units (DUs) for the Serverless instance. Valid values: 1, 2, 4, 8, and 16.

<props="intl">
> This feature is currently not supported. Do not specify this parameter.</props>
<props="china">
> This parameter is valid and required only when ChargeType is set to **sync_serverless**.</props>.

description.zh:
预付费实例的计费方式，取值：
- **Year**：包年。
- **Month**：包月。

> 当**ChargeType**为**PrePaid**（预付费）时，该参数才有效且必须传入。
description.en:
The billing method of the subscription instance. Valid values:
- **Year**: annual subscription.
- **Month**: monthly subscription.

> This parameter is valid and required only when ChargeType is set to **PrePaid** (subscription).

description.zh: 实例所属的地域，请参见[支持的地域列表](~~141033~~)。
description.en: The region ID of the instance. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

descriptions.zh:
<props="china">请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解云数据库DTS产品的收费方式和[价格](https://www.aliyun.com/price/product#/dts/detail)。
</props>
<props="intl">请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解云数据库DTS产品的收费方式和[价格](https://www.alibabacloud.com/zh/product/data-transmission-service/pricing)。
</props>

- 为避免您的资源浪费，在实例转换付费方式操作前确认要进行转换操作。
- 数据迁移实例只支持按量付费，无需转换。
<props="china">
- Serverless实例不支持转换付费方式。</props>
descriptions.en:
<props="china">Before you call this operation, make sure that you fully understand the billing methods and [pricing](https://www.aliyun.com/price/product#/dts/detail) of Data Transmission Service (DTS).
</props>
<props="intl">Before you call this operation, make sure that you fully understand the billing methods and [pricing](https://www.alibabacloud.com/zh/product/data-transmission-service/pricing) of Data Transmission Service (DTS).
</props>

- To avoid resource waste, confirm the payment method transformation before you perform the operation.
- Data migration instances support only the pay-as-you-go billing method. No transformation is required.
<props="china">
- Serverless instances do not support payment method transformation.</props>

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts transfer-pay-type --dts-job-id o4nh3g7jg560000 --charge-type PostPaid --period Year --buy-count 5 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --min-du 1 --max-du 16 --auto-pay true --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --instance-class example-string --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
